title: COVID19 direct ODE reproducibility release
description: Companion reproduction archive for From serological calibration to scenario credibility: retrospective evaluation of a multiwave COVID-19 model. Includes exact ODE source, frozen aggregate public surveillance inputs, saved fitted states/results, protocols, portable table/figure analysis and replay verification. All 21 compared replay outputs matched byte for byte; all 32 paper tables matched numerically and ten figure PNGs matched byte for byte. Fits were reused rather than re-estimated. Earlier projection source recovery remains incomplete and is explicitly disclosed. Software retains its MIT license; third-party data retain their original provider terms.
